description: Acquires quarterly USPS-derived ZIP-to-county evidence from HUD for current ZIP coverage and address-weighted jurisdiction mapping.
retry: Retry rate limits and transient service errors with server-directed or exponential backoff.
checkpoint: Persist page checkpoints by immutable run ID without storing the token.
idempotency: Quarter and source-record identity determine stable assertions; releases are immutable.
cancellation: Abort requests and keep partial pages isolated in the run staging directory.
retention_profile: Raw access-controlled source data is local-only until account terms and redistribution rights are reviewed.
